titulo.alumno:
«Передать просьбу или совет»
Reported speech: request and advice

intro: Requests and advice can be expressed with попросить/посоветовать + dative + infinitive, or with чтобы + a conjugated verb.

piezas.titulo: Requests and advice can be expressed with попросить/посоветовать + dative + infinitive, or with чтобы + a conjugated verb.
texto: Requests and advice can be expressed with попросить/посоветовать + dative + infinitive, or with чтобы + a conjugated verb.
The structure depends on the subject: Он попросил меня подождать; Он попросил, чтобы я подождал.

frases.alumno: The doctor advised the patient to rest more.

frases.estudio: Редактор попросил автора, чтобы тот проверил цитату.
frases.alumno: The editor asked the author to check the quotation.

pregunta.texto: What construction appears in «advised the patient to rest»?

opciones.explicacion: The recipient of the advice goes in the dative and then an infinitive follows.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Врач посоветовал пациенту больше отдыхать.»

opciones.texto: The doctor advised the patient to rest more.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The editor asked the author to check the quotation.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Редактор попросил автора, чтобы тот проверил цитату

piezas.traduccion: The editor asked the author to check the quotation.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
